bio:
Child of Stephen and Julia Ann Scott of Kingston (FamilySearch; probable). 10 in 1850.

FamilySearch gives Hannah's marriage to John S. Jones (1834-1904) in 1856 and her death on 17 Feb 1910. It has a child born in Wales in 1861, so the couple apparently spent time in Wales ([R4-S1]). A Social Security file for her son Frank Sylvester Jones names his mother as Hanna Scott.
sources: [R4-S1] FamilySearch published tree, Hannah Scott (G7LQ-QMP), with attached index entries (derivative) https://www.familysearch.org/service/tree/tree-data/published/persons/G7LQ-QMP
